entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I ordered a jersey a while back and it's just been sitting here. I'm so confused about what to do. The website is a little overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To start, could you tell me a bit more about the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's just... it's the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's way too tight. I was hoping I could exchange it, but I don't know if it's too late. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I just need to pull up your order details. Do you have the order number handy?
Umm, let me see... yes, it's VF886-0921.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered about 51 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy for you.
Oh, 51 days... is that bad? I feel so silly for waiting.
Not at all. I've just confirmed, and for this jersey, we have a 90-day return and exchange window. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can do an exchange for a bigger size?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the original jersey back in its box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex! You've made this so easy. I was really worried.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
